Class RmiClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.network.rmi.RmiClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView, RmiServerRemote, ClientHandler, Remote
public class RmiClientHandler extends Object implements RmiServerRemote, ClientHandler
Server-side handler for a single RMI-connected client.

Inbound RMI calls (client → server) are executed directly on the RMI thread pool — no extra executor needed, because the client's outbound queue already breaks the synchronicity chain on the other end.

Outbound notifications (server → client) are queued as RmiClientHandler.RmiCall lambdas and drained by a dedicated worker thread, so that GameController never blocks on a slow or dead client while holding its lock.

Keep-alive is handled by a dedicated ping thread that fires at a fixed interval regardless of outbound traffic, matching the design of SocketClientHandler.
